info.name: MessMate · 09 · Dashboards
info.description:
Tinta role-er tin rokom home screen. Sob gulo-i **provisional** — mash close na hoya porjonto rate bodlate thakbe (`isProvisional: true`).
---

### ⚠️ Ei collection ta alada (standalone)

Alada collection-er moddhe **collection variable share hoy na**. Tai sob id
**environment**-e rakha hoy — sob collection ekei environment dekhe.

**Chalanor age:**

1. Upore daan pashe environment dropdown-e **"MessMate — Local"** select kora ache kina dekho
2. **`01 · Auth`** collection theke ei tinta chalao (ekbar chalalei jothesto):
   - `Login — Owner` → token
   - `Me` → messId, membershipId
   - `Setup — load current period` → periodId

Erpor ei collection-er request gulo kaj korbe.

**Environment select na thakle** `{{messId}}` khali theke jabe ar `400` ashbe.

exec: // Mess-er timezone (Asia/Dhaka, UTC+6) dhore date variable set kora hoy,
// jate cutoff test gulo tomar computer-er timezone-e bhul na hoy.
try { pm.environment.set("today", iso(nowDhaka)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("tomorrow", plus(1)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("plus2", plus(2)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("plus3", plus(3)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("farFuture", plus(17)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("currentMonth", iso(nowDhaka).slice(0, 7)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Ek member-er home screen-er sob number ek call-e.

**Ja pabe:** ajker meal, ei maser mot meal, cholti meal rate, onuman kora khoroch, joma, ar **onuman balance**.

**⚠️ `isProvisional: true`** — mash close na howa porjonto rate bodlabe, karon nichher bhagfol (mot meal) barte thakbe. UI-te eta "chuda-nto na" bole dekhano uchit.

**Ke parbe:** je kono member.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Puro mess-er obostha — koyjon active, ajke koyjon kheyeche, mot meal, food vs fixed kharcha, cholti rate, mot joma, ar **cash position**.

**`cashPosition`** = mot joma − mot kharcha. `+` mane mess-er hate taka ache, `−` mane kharcha beshi hoye geche.

**`openPeriods`** — kon kon mash ekhono khola, mane close korte baki.

**Ke parbe:** ACCOUNTANT+.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Randhunir screen — koyta breakfast/lunch/dinner ranna korte hobe, ar kar kar jonno.

**Bishesh:** ekhane **ekta taka-o nei**. Cook-er financial data dekhar odhikar nei, tai API-teo pathano hoy na.

**Ke parbe:** COOK+.

**Expect:** `200`
